[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (56.1→64.1) + 과매수 진입 중 판단 + 상승 모멘텀 강화 해석
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-1.7878→-0.7523) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 가능성
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(상단 $550.46) 상단 돌파 + 밴드폭 7.36%로 변동성 확대 구간
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($517.55): SMA50 기반 지지력 확인
· 스윙 저항선 ($555.45): 현재가 근접, 돌파 시 추가 상승 여력
· 5일 고가($559.15) 갱신, 20일 고가($559.15)와 동일: 강세 패턴 지속
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.24배): 움직임의 신뢰도 상승, 매수세 유입 확인
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 5일 고가 갱신 및 RSI 과매수 진입으로 매수 진입 조건 충족
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($554.94) vs SMA5 ($527.02)/SMA20 ($530.92)/SMA50 ($515.33): trading above short- and mid-term trends, confirming bullish position.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($469.20)/SMA200 ($437.96): maintaining strong mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (98.0%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (56.1→64.1) + classified as entering overbought + interpreted as strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.7878→-0.7523) + diagnosed as improving + potential for trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (upper band $550.46) broken through + band width at 7.36% indicating expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($517.55): confirmed support based on SMA50.
· Swing resistance ($555.45): current price approaching, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day high ($559.15) renewed, same as 20-day high ($559.15): strong pattern continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.24x): increased confidence in price movement, confirming inflow of buying pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend): 5-day high renewal and RSI entering overbought meet buy entry conditions.
